phase_plan: P0 freeze (this) -> P1 alignment repair -> P2 repair policy -> P3 per-case rulings + trusted dev -> dual re-eval -> then decide training

classification_definitions.all_distinct: canonical methods under the run all differ -> repeat is NOT a uniform loop count (distinct calls collapsed by family RLE). Expansion candidate, per-case granularity judgment required.
classification_definitions.mixed: both identical and distinct calls under the run -> neither loop nor condition-count wholesale; per-group structure recovery required.
classification_definitions.all_identical: same canonical METHOD NAME repeated -> necessary-but-NOT-sufficient for a loop (canonical chain carries no arguments; same method with different args is NOT excluded).
classification_definitions.alignment_mismatch: semantic vs canonical chain lengths differ -> positional mapping unreliable; NOT a confirmed gold error; evidence-alignment problem first.

known_limitations: C6 positional alignment is 1:1; 788 stages flagged alignment_mismatch pending P1
